title: The Throne-Structure of Divine Dominion
description: A cosmography of dominion. The complete throne-structure unfolds in two parallel registers: nine outer thrones in the aeons of the Greatness (Father, Mother of Life, First Man, Beloved of Lights, Great Builder, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, the Great One), then nine corresponding thrones inside the cosmos through ships, firmaments, and the air, ending at the Judge of Truth who divides every soul to death, life, or agreement.
